I am old now, 74 years, and my back is not what it was. My son works in the city so it is mostly me and my husband on our 5 mu. I have been doing this 35 years, same fields, same way my mother-in-law taught me. I cannot read, but I know my land.

I will split the fields like last year. About 2 mu for cotton, and 3 mu for spring maize. Cotton gives more cash if the price holds, but maize we need for ourselves and for some feed. I do not want to put all in cotton — too risky, and cotton is too much spraying work for these old hands.

For the maize, I buy the seed from the same dealer in the township. The hybrid seed, the one in the blue bag — my neighbor Old Wang uses it and his maize is tall and full. I do not know the name, I just point to the bag. One bag is enough for my 3 mu.

Before planting, my nephew brings the tractor and does the rotary for me — 30 yuan per mu, cheaper than ploughing deep. For fertilizer, I put 2 bags of compound (that big white bag, the 15-15-15 kind) per mu before planting, and then when the maize is knee-high I broadcast urea, maybe half a bag per mu. Better too much than too little — if the maize is yellow and short, the whole year is wasted. Fertilizer money I can lose, yield I cannot.

Water from the well — I irrigate when planting, once when it tassels, and once when the kernel fills. Three times, maybe four if the sky is dry. Electricity for the pump is expensive now, so I watch the weather. Spray I only do once or twice, for the borer, when I see the neighbors spraying I spray too.

For cotton, it is harder. I use the same seed the village cooperative sells, the improved kind. Cotton eats more fertilizer than maize — I put 2 bags of compound and then urea twice, once at squaring, once at flowering. About 20 jin of urea each time per mu. Potash I add a little more because the old people say cotton likes potash for the bolls.

Cotton needs spraying many times — aphids, bollworm, mirid bugs. I spray maybe 6 or 7 times. It is tiring but if I skip, the bolls are ruined. Water I give 3 or 4 times through the season. I plough the cotton field because the roots go deep, rotary is not enough.

I expect maize around 500 kg per mu, like last year. Cotton maybe 230 kg of seed cotton per mu if the weather is good. If there is hail or the bollworm is bad, less. I do not plan high — I plan for normal year.
